requirement: A curated claim must identify exactly which biological statement it describes
label: subject
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Complements existing COM-11 rdf:Statement; RDF reification describes a statement but does NOT by itself assert the underlying triple. Compare SEPIO-based proposition model before adoption.

requirement: A curated claim must identify exactly which biological statement it describes
label: predicate
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Complements existing COM-11 rdf:Statement; RDF reification describes a statement but does NOT by itself assert the underlying triple. Compare SEPIO-based proposition model before adoption.

requirement: A curated claim must identify exactly which biological statement it describes
label: object
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Complements existing COM-11 rdf:Statement; RDF reification describes a statement but does NOT by itself assert the underlying triple. Compare SEPIO-based proposition model before adoption.

requirement: A pathway claim distinguishes experimentally supported involvement from proposed catalysis or unresolved function
label: claim status
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Controlled IRIs proposed for supported, proposed, refuted, unresolved. Evidence type and assertion status are distinct; do not infer a characterized reaction from a genetic phenotype.

requirement: An evidence record identifies its precise source location within a paper or dataset
label: source locator
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Structured source location such as figure panel, table, supplemental figure, page, or accession. Source publication itself is already PMN-10 dcterms:references.

requirement: A curated evidence-backed claim identifies the publication or source from which it was derived
label: was derived from
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Use at claim level, not just on genes. Compare existing PMN-10 dcterms:references for bibliographic citations.

requirement: A curation activity records the responsible human curator or software agent
label: was associated with
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Used on activity nodes already generated via COM-03; agent provenance is different from original publication authorship.

requirement: An observed loss-of-function phenotype supports a gene-pathway involvement claim
label: loss-of-function mutant phenotype evidence
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Use as evidence type for mutant phenotype only; does not directly establish the exact enzyme catalytic step. Verified ECO identifier.

requirement: A direct enzymatic activity assay supports a specified substrate-product transformation
label: enzymatic activity assay evidence
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Direct biochemical assay evidence; narrower than generic experimental evidence in PMN-03.

requirement: The same evidence may support one claim, contradict another, or be inconclusive
label: evidence assessment
notes: [P1 REVIEW] A relationship-specific assessment object links claim, evidence, assessment outcome and curator; compare SEPIO evidence lines before finalizing.

requirement: An evidence assessment explicitly states support, contradiction or inconclusive outcome
label: assessment outcome
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Allowed value IRIs: supports, contradicts, inconclusive. Attach to assessment, NOT globally to experiment or evidence record; same experiment may bear differently on claims.

requirement: A published BGC has genome-assembly-specific chromosome coordinates and genomic boundaries
label: location
notes: [P2 REVIEW] Link BGC or its locus to a FALDO Region; boundaries use exact-position nodes with positions and a reference sequence. Reuse existing BGC-16 genomeAssembly; avoid made-up coordinates.

requirement: A published BGC has genome-assembly-specific chromosome coordinates and genomic boundaries
label: begin
notes: [P2 REVIEW] Link BGC or its locus to a FALDO Region; boundaries use exact-position nodes with positions and a reference sequence. Reuse existing BGC-16 genomeAssembly; avoid made-up coordinates.

requirement: A published BGC has genome-assembly-specific chromosome coordinates and genomic boundaries
label: end
notes: [P2 REVIEW] Link BGC or its locus to a FALDO Region; boundaries use exact-position nodes with positions and a reference sequence. Reuse existing BGC-16 genomeAssembly; avoid made-up coordinates.

requirement: A published BGC has genome-assembly-specific chromosome coordinates and genomic boundaries
label: position
notes: [P2 REVIEW] Link BGC or its locus to a FALDO Region; boundaries use exact-position nodes with positions and a reference sequence. Reuse existing BGC-16 genomeAssembly; avoid made-up coordinates.

requirement: An expression module records explicit gene membership per clustering analysis
label: has module member
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Use with existing PO-08 lodp:functionalCluster; distinguish physical BGC members (BGC-02) from analysis-dependent transcriptomic module assignments.

requirement: A gene can be weakly associated with a module without being assigned as its member
label: module affinity finding
notes: [P1 REVIEW] First-class analysis-dependent association with a gene, module and originating run; do not assert membership solely from weak affinity.

requirement: Module similarity strength or membership score is recorded with its measurement method
label: module affinity score
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Value depends on algorithm: kME (signed -1..1), distance, stability, etc. Store score type/algorithm with analysis, not a universal 0..1 range.

requirement: A gene-gene coexpression analysis result can be an association resource carrying its own statistics
label: association
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Already present for ML predictions (UN-01); reuse as general first-class finding. Reuse TX-14 Pearson/Spearman and PO-02 SIO refers-to instead of inventing another relation.

requirement: Gene-metabolite temporal association is a first-class analysis-derived finding
label: lagged association finding
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Candidate subclass of existing PO-01 SIO:001257 chemical-gene association (or generic SIO:000897); analysis records direction, lag convention and evidence provenance.

requirement: A lagged association points to an explicitly unit-bearing temporal shift
label: best lag
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Point to a qudt:QuantityValue with numericValue and unit; use time vs sample index vs pseudotime distinction from PO-16.

requirement: A lagged association points to an explicitly unit-bearing temporal shift
label: quantity value
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Use a separate quantity node rather than treating 24 as hours without a declared unit.

requirement: A lagged association points to an explicitly unit-bearing temporal shift
label: numeric value
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Use on qudt:QuantityValue for lag magnitude. Validate number >0 for nonzero-lag findings.

requirement: A lagged association points to an explicitly unit-bearing temporal shift
label: unit
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Use http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/HR for measured hours; pseudo-time has no automatic conversion to hours.

requirement: Lag sign convention and biological temporal direction are explicit
label: lag direction
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Controlled values: transcript_leads_metabolite, metabolite_leads_transcript, unknown; define lag positive as corr(G(t),M(t+L)), L>0. Never assume signs are same across methods.

requirement: The time axis used to estimate lag is recorded explicitly
label: lag axis
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Controlled values: elapsed_clock_time, sample_step, pseudotime; units / shapes differ and pseudotime is not automatically measured in hours.

requirement: A temporal association records zero-lag and best-lag correlation estimates separately
label: zero-lag correlation
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Numeric literal in [-1,1]. Link result to correlation method; existing PO-04/TX-14 STATO terms identify statistic type, not automatically a literal-valued predicate.

requirement: A temporal association records zero-lag and best-lag correlation estimates separately
label: best-lag correlation
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Numeric literal in [-1,1]. Specify whether lag maximizes signed r, absolute r, or another score; not evidence of catalysis.

requirement: Lag association records number of valid aligned observation pairs after shifting
label: aligned pair count
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Integer count of valid paired samples/time positions after aligning signals; distinguish effective independent time points from replicate count.

requirement: Lag analysis records the set or range of candidate lags searched
label: lag search window
notes: [P2 REVIEW] Parameter of the analysis run; specify candidate lags, units and grid so significance can account for lag selection (multiple comparisons).

requirement: Lag analysis identifies how the best lag or score was selected
label: lag optimization criterion
notes: [P2 REVIEW] Methods such as max_positive_r, max_absolute_r, minimum_distance, cross-correlation peak. Store with analysis run; do not mix incomparable scores.

requirement: The two omics datasets and sample/time-point alignment manifest are traceable
label: used
notes: [P1 REVIEW] Already exists in COM-04; require both datasets and alignment manifest as inputs to the analysis. Reuse existing vocab and new SHACL constraints rather than new ontology terms.

requirement: A graphical pathway element can be represented as a separate resource from the biological entity
label: diagram element
notes: [P2 REVIEW] Optional educational/pilot metadata. Review whether GPML vocabulary has an appropriate equivalent; separate diagram node from biology.

requirement: A diagram element points to the gene, protein, metabolite or reaction it depicts
label: depicts
notes: [P2 REVIEW] Map GPML elements to RDF entities; do not assert graph connectivity from visual arrows alone. Review existing graphical vocab before minting.

requirement: The GPML element has an identifier within the corresponding diagram file
label: GPML element ID
notes: [P2 REVIEW] Use diagram-scoped ID; together with file / version ensures unique identity. Validate corresponding GPML element exists.
